title: 第1079章 暴怒的白剑第1078章 后手
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
如果将九天玄阵中凝练的剑意比作山石。
那元始天尊和通天的炼化镇压之力就是锋利的锄头。
然而此刻。
锄头落下。
山石纹丝不动。
反而是两人的镇压和炼化之力反弹回来，连那剑意的一丝碎片都没撕扯下来。
两位圣人却是不知。
守护剑道，本就不主动攻伐。
如今落于九天玄阵之中，没有陈怀安引导更是只守不攻，根基稳固到了极致。
它们与九天玄阵的阵纹，与地脉的龙气死死缠在一起，你中有我，我中有你，像是长在了地脉里。
此刻若要强行炼化，便等于要刨开整方世界的地脉根基，只会刺激得剑意越发躁动。
二人越是催动力量去炼化，阵中的剑意便越是狂暴。
就像一团无法销毁的炽烈天火。
越是泼水，它烧得越旺。
越是去拆，它炸得越快。
“不行！炼化不了！”通天教主脸色铁青，抽回剑气，“再炼下去，只会逼得它提前爆发！”
元始天尊也收回了法力，面色凝重。
他也看出来了。
这些剑意就像先天生成的地脉之毒，清除不掉，销毁不了，强行出手只会适得其反。
“不能炼，那便封！”元始天尊沉声道，“以你我二人的圣道本源加持阵纹，层层封禁，把剑意死死封在阵中，让它永远也爆发不出来！”

这些圣道剑意不能为他们所用的确是一件遗憾的事情。
但不能为他们所用，也不会便宜别人。
这剑意此刻就像无法消解的凶物，既然不能清除，便只能在外层筑起最坚固的牢笼，将它永久封存。
通天教主略一沉吟，便点头同意。
事到如今，也只有这个办法了。
二人不再迟疑，同时催动自身圣道本源。
元始以玉清道韵加持阵纹，一道道金色禁制刻入玄阵外层，加固防御，稳定地脉。
通天则以截教杀道布下杀阵封禁，一道道黑色剑纹环绕阵法，一旦剑意异动，便先行绞杀缓冲。
玉清的厚重，加上上清的凌厉，两道圣人级别的封禁，一层一层地叠加在九天玄阵之外。
而阵中，陈怀安留下的守护剑意，本就承担着护持阵基的作用。
外界封禁之力越强，守护剑意便越是稳固，自发地与外层禁制呼应契合，再悄无声息地相融。
一内一外。
一守一封。
陈怀安的守护剑意打底，元始的玉清禁制加固，通天的杀道剑阵兜底。
三尊圣人的力量，以这样一种诡异的方式，尽数落在了九天玄阵之上。
原本就吸收了海量圣力的九天玄阵，经此一遭，阵基被打磨得更加坚不可摧。
阵纹层层叠叠，愈发闪耀。
可以预见的是，此刻九天玄阵的防御之强，恐怕十个元始天尊联手都未必能再撼动分毫。
这就等于是三尊圣人联手，给这座大阵上了三道保险。
content_en:
If the condensed sword intent in the Nine Heavens Mysterious Formation is compared to a mountain stone.
The refining and suppressing power of Yuanshi Tianzun and Tongtian is like a sharp hoe.
But at this moment.
The hoe fell.
The rocks are motionless.
Instead, the suppressive and refining power of the two people rebounded, without even tearing off a single fragment of the sword intent.
But the two saints didn't know.
To protect the way of swordsmanship, one does not take the initiative to attack.
Now that he is in the Nine Heavens Mysterious Formation, without Chen Huaian's guidance, he can only defend but not attack, and his foundation is extremely stable.
They are tightly intertwined with the formations of the Nine Heavens Profound Formation and the dragon energy of the earth's veins. I am in you, and you are in me, as if they have grown in the earth's veins.
If you want to forcibly refine it at this moment, it will be equivalent to digging out the foundation of the entire world, which will only stimulate the sword's will to become more and more restless.
The more the two of them mobilized their power to refine, the more violent the sword intent in the formation became.
Like a blazing fire from heaven that cannot be destroyed.
The more water is poured on it, the more it burns.
The more you try to dismantle it, the faster it explodes.
"No! It can't be refined!" Master Tongtian's face turned pale as he withdrew his sword energy, "If you continue to refine it, it will only force it to explode in advance!"
Yuanshi Tianzun also withdrew his magic power and looked solemn.
He saw it too.
These sword intentions are like the innate poison of the earth's veins. They cannot be removed or destroyed. Forcibly attacking them will only be counterproductive.
"If you can't practice it, then seal it!" Yuanshi Tianzun said solemnly, "Use the holy origin of you and me to bless the formation pattern, seal it layer by layer, and seal the sword intent in the formation, so that it can never explode!"
It is indeed a pity that these holy swords cannot be used by them.
But it cannot be used by them, and it will not benefit others.
This sword intent is like an indestructible evil at this moment. Since it cannot be eliminated, we can only build the strongest cage on the outer layer to seal it permanently.
Leader Tongtian thought for a moment, then nodded in agreement.
As of now, this is the only way.
The two of them no longer hesitated and activated their holy path origins at the same time.
At the beginning of the Yuan Dynasty, Yuqing Daoyun was used to bless the array pattern, and golden prohibitions were carved into the outer layer of the Xuan array to strengthen the defense and stabilize the earth's veins.
Tongtian used the Jie Jiao Killing Dao to set up a killing formation and seal it. Black sword patterns surrounded the formation. Once the sword intention changed, it would strangle and buffer first.
The thickness of the jade clear, coupled with the sharpness of the upper clear, two saint-level bans were superimposed layer by layer outside the Nine Heavens Mysterious Formation.
In the formation, the guardian sword intention left by Chen Huaian was already responsible for protecting the base of the formation.
The stronger the power of the external ban, the more stable the guardian sword will be, spontaneously echoing and fitting with the outer ban, and then blending in silently.
One inside and one outside.
Keep one letter at a time.
Chen Huaian's Guardian Sword Intent is the foundation, Yuan Shi's Yuqing Restriction is reinforced, and Tongtian's Killing Sword Formation is the foundation.
The power of the three saints fell on the Nine Heavens Xuan Formation in such a strange way.
The Nine Heavens Mysterious Formation, which had already absorbed a massive amount of holy power, had been polished to become even more indestructible after this experience.
The array patterns are layered upon each other, becoming more and more shining.
It is foreseeable that the defense of the Nine Heavens Mysterious Formation at this moment is so strong that ten Yuanshi Tianzun together may not be able to shake it even a little bit.
This is equivalent to three saints joining forces to provide three insurances for this formation.
